name: Domino Poker
summary: A straight poker adaptation played with 20 dominoes where players ante, bet and show five-tile hands.
rules_text: A 20 tile set is used: a double-six set minus blanks and 1-1. 2-4 players ante into a pot. Deal 5 tiles face down to each player, remainder face down unused. In turn clockwise from eldest, each player may check (first round only if no bet yet), fold and forfeit, bet (first bet of round), call (match current total), or raise (overcall plus announced extra) within agreed min/max limits. Betting ends when all active players have matched the highest bet. Active hands are exposed and highest ranked wins the pot. Ranking high to low: 5 doubles Royal, Straight Sixes, Four of a kind (four doubles), Straight Fives, Full House (three doubles plus two of same suit), Straight Fours, Three of a kind, Flush (5 same suit), One pair (two doubles, higher doubles wins ties), High card (highest double then highest pip).
rating_reason: Straight poker with dominoes, specific showdown bluffing bidding game.
